WITH Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(

select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid
)

,Balance AS (

SELECT DISTINCT
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BLLF.[Timestamp],112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountID AS AccountID
,BCRL.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
,BLS.LimSanctDate 
,BCUS.CoreCustomerId 
,BLST.StatusCode 
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode
,BLS.SanctLim 
,BLLF.LimitLiabilityAmount 
,DCA.CNT
,BLS.FinancialInstitutionId 
FROM [BNKM].[CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability] BCRL 
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[LimitLiabilitySanction] BLS ON BLS.LimitId = BCRL.LimitB2KId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccountParticipation] BCAP ON BCRL.CustomerAccountId = BCAP.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BCRL.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1

LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BLS.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID 
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DCA.AccountId = BCRL.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[Customer] BCUS ON BCA.CustomerId = BCUS.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[LimitLiabilityStatus] BLST ON BLS.LimitId = BLST.LimitId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[LimitLiabilityFund] BLLF ON BLS.LimitId = BLLF.LimitId
WHERE BCRL.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS'								   
)

select * into dw.factlnscredlim_Balance from Balance

with GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
    BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,convert(DATE, MIN(BusinessDateSK)) AS min_date
    ,CONVERT(DATE, MAX(BusinessDateSK)) AS max_date 
  FROM 
     dw.factlnscredlim_Balance
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL) AND BusinessDateSK between '20230626' and  '20230703'
	GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
	,SourceSystemCode
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,fulldate,112) AS fulldate2
    ,a.FullDate
    ,b.min_date 
    ,b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,distinct_balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountId, BusinessDateSK, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm ,LimSanctDate  ,CoreCustomerId  ,StatusCode  ,IsoCurrencyCode ,SanctLim  ,LimitLiabilityAmount  ,CNT ,FinancialInstitutionId
FROM  dw.factlnscredlim_Balance b
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
, join_balance as (
select 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate),112)  AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm                           
,LimSanctDate  
,CoreCustomerId  
,StatusCode  
,IsoCurrencyCode 
,SanctLim  
,LimitLiabilityAmount  
,CNT
,FinancialInstitutionId
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row#
, case when [SanctLim] is null then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

)
select * into dw.factlnscredlim_join_balance from join_balance;
select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY BankSK, AccountId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup into dw.factlnscredlim_rowgrp from dw.factlnscredlim_join_balance

with final_balance as (
select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,case when IsoCurrencyCode is not null then IsoCurrencyCode else first_value(IsoCurrencyCode) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end IsoCurrencyCode
,case when FinancialInstitutionId is not null then FinancialInstitutionId else first_value(FinancialInstitutionId) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end FinancialInstitutionId
,case when [LimSanctDate] is not null then LimSanctDate else first_value(LimSanctDate) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end LimSanctDate
,case when [CoreCustomerId] is not null then CoreCustomerId else first_value(CoreCustomerId) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end CoreCustomerId
,case when [CNT] is not null then CNT else first_value(CNT) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end CNT
,case when [StatusCode] is not null then StatusCode else first_value(StatusCode) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end StatusCode
,case when [SanctLim] is not null then SanctLim else first_value(SanctLim) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end SanctLim
,case when [LimitLiabilityAmount] is not null then LimitLiabilityAmount else first_value(LimitLiabilityAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end LimitLiabilityAmount
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm                           
from dw.factlnscredlim_rowgrp) 

select * into dw.factlnscredlim_final_balance from final_balance;

with CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
,Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(
select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid
)

select
 BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,CASE WHEN CoreCustomerId IN (SELECT DISTINCT CoreCustomerId FROM bnkm.LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping)
            AND StatusCode IN ('NEW', 'RENEW', 'EXTND', 'EXPRD')
            AND LimitLiabilityAmount != 0
      THEN CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN  SanctLim * CC.ConversionRate 
                ELSE SanctLim  END
 ELSE 0 END
  AS CreditLimitAmountFull
,CASE WHEN CoreCustomerId IN (SELECT DISTINCT CoreCustomerId FROM bnkm.LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping)
            AND StatusCode IN ('NEW', 'RENEW', 'EXTND', 'EXPRD')
            AND LimitLiabilityAmount != 0
      THEN CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN  (SanctLim * CC.ConversionRate) / CNT 
                ELSE SanctLim / CNT END 
 ELSE 0 END 
  AS CreditLimitAmountProrated
,SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
INTO dw.factlnscredlim_final_balance_union1
FROM dw.factlnscredlim_final_balance A
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,BusinessDateSK) = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp

drop table dw.factlnscredlim_Balance
drop table dw.factlnscredlim_join_balance
drop table dw.factlnscredlim_rowgrp
drop table dw.factlnscredlim_final_balance
drop table dw.factlnscredlim_final_balance_union1

WITH 
CustomerAccountLimit
AS(
      SELECT * FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountLimit] WHERE LimitTypeId = 'Sanction Limit Amount' AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
)
, Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(
select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid
)

,Balance AS (

SELECT DISTINCT
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAL.[Timestamp],112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountID AS AccountID
,BCAL.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
,BCUS.CoreCustomerId
,BCAL.IsoCurrencyCode
,BCAL.LimitAmount
,DCA.CNT
,BCAL.FinancialInstitutionId 
FROM 
CustomerAccountLimit BCAL 
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BCAL.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAL.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BCAL.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BCAL.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN BNKM.RepaymentPlanPayment BRRP ON BRRP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAL.FinancialInstitutionId AND  BRRP.CustomerAccountId = BCAL.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[Customer] BCUS ON BCA.CustomerId = BCUS.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DCA.AccountId = BCAL.CustomerAccountId
   
)

select * into dw.factlnscredlim2_Balance from Balance

with GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
    BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,convert(DATE, MIN(BusinessDateSK)) AS min_date
    ,CONVERT(DATE, MAX(BusinessDateSK)) AS max_date 
  FROM 
     dw.factlnscredlim2_Balance
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL) AND BusinessDateSK BETWEEN '20230626' and '20230703'
	GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
	,SourceSystemCode
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,fulldate,112) AS fulldate2
    ,a.FullDate
    ,b.min_date 
    ,b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,distinct_balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountId, BusinessDateSK, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm ,CoreCustomerId ,IsoCurrencyCode ,LimitAmount ,CNT ,FinancialInstitutionId 
FROM  dw.factlnscredlim2_Balance b
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
, join_balance as (
select 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate),112)  AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm                           
,CoreCustomerId 
,IsoCurrencyCode 
,LimitAmount 
,CNT 
,FinancialInstitutionId 
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row#
, case when [LimitAmount] is null then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

)
select * into dw.factlnscredlim2_join_balance from join_balance;
select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY BankSK, AccountId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup into dw.factlnscredlim2_rowgrp from dw.factlnscredlim2_join_balance

with final_balance as (
select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,case when IsoCurrencyCode is not null then IsoCurrencyCode else first_value(IsoCurrencyCode) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end IsoCurrencyCode
,case when FinancialInstitutionId is not null then FinancialInstitutionId else first_value(FinancialInstitutionId) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end FinancialInstitutionId
,case when [LimitAmount] is not null then LimitAmount else first_value(LimitAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end LimitAmount
,case when [CoreCustomerId] is not null then CoreCustomerId else first_value(CoreCustomerId) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end CoreCustomerId
,case when [CNT] is not null then CNT else first_value(CNT) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end CNT
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm                           
from dw.factlnscredlim2_rowgrp) 

select * into dw.factlnscredlim2_final_balance from final_balance;

with CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
,Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(
select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid
)
SELECT DISTINCT
 BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,CASE WHEN CoreCustomerId NOT IN (SELECT CoreCustomerId FROM bnkm.LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping)
      THEN CASE WHEN  IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN LimitAmount * CC.ConversionRate
                ELSE LimitAmount END
      ELSE 0 END
  AS CreditLimitAmountFull

,CASE WHEN CoreCustomerId NOT IN (SELECT CoreCustomerId FROM bnkm.LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping)
      THEN CASE WHEN  IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (LimitAmount * CC.ConversionRate) / CNT
                ELSE LimitAmount / CNT END
  ELSE 0 END 
  AS CreditLimitAmountProrated
,SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
INTO dw.factlnscredlim_final_balance_union2 
FROM dw.factlnscredlim2_final_balance A
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId and CONVERT(VARCHAR,BusinessDateSK) = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp

drop table dw.factlnscredlim2_Balance
drop table dw.factlnscredlim2_join_balance
drop table dw.factlnscredlim2_rowgrp
drop table dw.factlnscredlim2_final_balance
drop table dw.factlnscredlim_final_balance_union2

INSERT INTO DW.FactLoansCreditLimit
(
 [BusinessDateSK]
,[BranchSK]
,[BankSK]
,[AccountSK]
,[AccountID]
,[CreditLimitAmountFull]
,[CreditLimitAmountProrated]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT  
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CONVERT(DATE,BusinessDateSK),112) AS BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,SUM(CreditLimitAmountFull)  CreditLimitAmountFull
,SUM(CreditLimitAmountProrated) CreditLimitAmountProrated
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
from (
select * from dw.factlnscredlim_final_balance_union1
UNION ALL
select * from dw.factlnscredlim_final_balance_union2
) A 
WHERE CreditLimitAmountFull <> 0 AND CreditLimitAmountProrated <> 0
GROUP BY 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
